policy.go_rule: All P0 automated tests PASS and all P0 BC sandbox/manual gates are completed with evidence.

tests.title: Idempotent tenant, environment and company registration
tests.expected: Repeated registration does not create conflicting identities or cross-tenant access.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit and backend regression log

tests.title: Tenant and company isolation
tests.expected: Foreign tenant and company resources are rejected.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Free scan and permanent result access
tests.expected: Completed free score keeps dashboard, findings summary and free report access without paid rights.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Canonical product policy with legacy guard
tests.expected: Paid capability requires canonical entitlement and legacy grant; mismatches fail closed.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Runtime policy drift diagnostics
tests.expected: Canonical and legacy mismatches are visible without changing the decision.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit and access snapshot assertions

tests.title: Atomic one-time credit consumption
tests.expected: Exactly one credit is consumed and retries cannot double-consume it.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Queued to terminal scan lifecycle
tests.expected: Runs reach completed, failed or cancelled and do not remain indefinitely running.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Lease, heartbeat and stale-run recovery
tests.expected: Lost workers are detected and stale runs are recovered without duplicate execution.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Executive report data and rendering contracts
tests.expected: Report payload, language, access and PDF generation remain valid.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit; Chromium/PDF artifact where available

tests.title: Data-health exceptions lifecycle and score exclusion
tests.expected: Create, duplicate guard, deactivate/reactivate, history and score/report exclusion are correct.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Monitoring scheduling and authorization
tests.expected: Only active monitoring tenants can schedule scans and duplicate execution is prevented.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: Checkout and webhook idempotency
tests.expected: Duplicate or reordered events do not duplicate licenses, credits or memberships.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit using test doubles/test mode

tests.title: Expiry and downgrade protection
tests.expected: Expired paid rights are removed while permanent free results remain available.
tests.evidence: pytest JUnit

tests.title: BC 27 AL compile with CodeCop and PTECop
tests.expected: Extension compiles and build plus warning artifacts are published.
tests.evidence: BC AL Compile and Cop Gate workflow

tests.title: Transactional PostgreSQL smoke test
tests.expected: Real PostgreSQL transaction, constraints and rollback behave as required.
tests.evidence: Test database URL and captured command output
tests.blocker: Requires reachable disposable PostgreSQL test database. SQLite is not accepted as evidence.

tests.title: Install extension in real Business Central sandbox
tests.expected: APP installs without dependency, permission or schema errors.
tests.evidence: BC Extension Management screenshot and version
tests.blocker: Requires real BC sandbox and authorized user/app registration.

tests.title: Real BC registration, free scan and result synchronization
tests.expected: BC registers the correct tenant/company, starts a free scan and receives the terminal result.
tests.evidence: Screenshots, run ID, tenant/company IDs and backend correlation ID
tests.blocker: Requires real BC sandbox, backend URL and credentials.

tests.title: Real paid assessment, findings, report and validation path
tests.expected: One credit is consumed, deep scan completes, findings/report are available and validation runs.
tests.evidence: Run IDs, credit before/after, report and BC screenshots
tests.blocker: Requires sandbox license/credit fixture and real BC execution.

tests.title: Real monitoring scheduler and job queue execution
tests.expected: Scheduled job executes once, records history and handles failure/retry safely.
tests.evidence: Job Queue entries, scheduled run and backend logs
tests.blocker: Requires real BC sandbox and elapsed scheduler window or controlled test trigger.

tests.title: Extension upgrade and retained configuration
tests.expected: Upgrade installs successfully and retains setup, history and access context.
tests.evidence: Before/after versions, setup and history screenshots
tests.blocker: Requires two signed/compiled APP versions and real BC sandbox.

tests.title: Guided setup and customer comprehension
tests.expected: A first-time user can complete setup and understand statuses, findings and next steps without developer help.
tests.evidence: Completed UAT checklist with observations
